reasons: The source audit had mistaken RaLD evaluation BCE for its training loss. Official RaLD training uses 0.1 times the occupied-query class mean BCE plus 1.0 times the empty-query class mean BCE at engine_ae.py lines 48-50 and 79-86, not one unweighted BCE over concatenated queries.

The G1D query-state MLP received a raw 64-bin natural-log energy sum around 1500 beside normalized spectrum and range features around unit scale. At the epoch-13 checkpoint, the median first-layer energy contribution was 2318.18 versus 0.2097 for the complete spectrum, a ratio of 11053.36.
Occupied queries had continuous cell jitter while empty queries remained at integer cell centers, so coordinate fractional phase leaked the class label and differed from inference-query coordinates.
The validation condition shuffle paired each frame with the next manifest entry; 16 of 24 pairs remained in the same sequence, violating the declared cross-scene intervention.

query_evidence_diagnostic_12_frames.interpretation: The labels retain useful local Cube and range separation; the collapse cannot be attributed to wholly indistinguishable query evidence.

disposition: Keep logs and checkpoints for audit only. Do not resume, select, compare, or cite them as G1D results. G1D v2 must use the official RaLD training class weights, train-only fixed absolute-energy normalization, default occupancy-head initialization, matched positive/empty query jitter, deterministic cross-scene condition derangement, and expanded scale/gradient preflight checks.
